summary: Clean electric guitar: funk rhythm, pop, R&B, reggae skank
label: clean electric guitar
body: Funk 16th chops, the reggae skank on 2 and 4, R&B chord stabs. Muted chops: GeneralUser GS/Muted Guitar; jazz: GeneralUser GS/Jazz Guitar.

Register: MIDI 40-84 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Clean Guitar, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Clean Guitar") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
